name: Agent Regression Lab
target_user: Teams building conversational agents on Temporal Agent Harness
problem: Agent changes can silently break multi-turn behavior and tool use; developers need repeatable evidence before shipping.
workaround: Manual conversations, ad hoc scripts, and model-only grading without durable execution traces.
temporal_advantage: Durable experiments survive worker restarts and correlate every case with its agent workflows.
harness_advantage: Typed agent messages, isolated subagents, peer judges, and tool events provide a reusable evaluation interface.
adoption_hypothesis: A team can connect one existing harness agent and reproduce a known regression within an hour, then use the saved suite before a release.
